_comment: The single definition of decline, position bands, quick wins, CTR gaps, lost queries and cannibalization for seo-audit. Read by scripts/gsc_bands.py, scripts/write_briefs.py and scripts/seo_state.py; quoted by the skills and the report template. A project overrides any key with a gsc_bands object in <project>/seo-audit/config.json (keys merged over this file). These are conventions of the stack, chosen to filter noise on small sites, not Google benchmarks: change them in one place, here.

quick_win._comment: Positions 4 to 20 with enough impressions: visible to Google, under-clicked. Opportunity = impressions x (position - 3).

decline._comment: Clicks down at least 20 % vs the prior period, with at least 10 prior clicks. Applied to queries and pages alike.

artifact._comment: Position stable and impressions falling on a deep position: check for a measurement change before calling it a decline (flag only, never a band).

lost._comment: In the top 20 in the prior period, absent or below 20 now.

ctr_gap._comment: CTR at least 25 % under the site's own median CTR of the same position bucket (never an outside CTR curve). Buckets with fewer than min_queries_per_bucket rows have no median.

cannibalization._comment: Two URLs or more of the site receive impressions on one query, each with at least this share of the query's impressions. Needs query x page rows (API JSON or a CSV with both columns).

tracking._comment: Follow-up of every modified page. Checkpoint N compares the N days after the ship date with the N days before it, once N + lag_days have passed (Search Console data arrives 2 to 3 days late). Outcome up or down needs both the percentage and the absolute click change; anything else is flat. An outcome is a correlation, never proof that the change caused it.
